flexible_post_content.text_editor:
O3 World co-founder and CEO Keith Scandone, recently connected with Marcel Petitpas, CEO of Parakeeto and host of The Agency Profit podcast, to discuss his journey in co-founding O3 World, what agency leaders must do to build and cultivate a culture of curiosity, as well as the lessons he’s learned from enduring the 2008-2009 recession.
